statement: let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); ∀ p a k : ℕ, p.Prime → 0<k → p^k ∣ a → (roots a (p^k)).card = p^(k/2)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0058 · 给出坏素数在低指数层的精确根数
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0058 · Count singular roots exactly in the initial valuation layers

brief.zh: 化为 r²≡0 mod p^k，代表元必须是 p^⌈k/2⌉ 的倍数。
brief.en: Reduce to r²≡0 mod p^k and count multiples of p^⌈k/2⌉.
